references.title: DWDS: morgen
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; Adverb; Etymologie under Morgen

notes.rationale: Ich könnte nun reisen, morgen etwa, tomorrow. An ADV takes no Source (ADR 0050), so it is a bottom word. DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung, so it is a bottom word, and indeclinable, so it has no Ending, not even ∅ (ADR 0051): the Root morgen alone.
